info.title: KiriChess Public API
info.description: The published bot/HTTP API (Phase 9f.5). Authenticate with a personal access token issued at POST /api/account/api-tokens (first-party, JWT only). Raw tokens start with `kirichess_pat_` and carry `read` and/or `play`. The 43-character secret is followed by a 6-character CRC-32 checksum. API-created games and challenges are always unrated; rated play is hub JoinQueue remapped onto bot:{preset}. Live clocks stay on /hubs/game. Those payloads are not HTTP, so they live in components.schemas referenced by no path, each marked with the x-kirichess-transport extension naming the hub and the event or method; /hubs/presence is omitted because an API token cannot authenticate there. How to call it is documented at https://kirichess.com/developers.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token issued once at POST /api/account/api-tokens. Prefix kirichess_pat_, then 43 secret characters and a 6-character CRC-32 checksum. Scopes: read, play.
